key_catalyst: Escalating Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure, keeping crude near $100 and reviving inflation and rate risk.
reasoning: Weekend Houthi attacks on Saudi oil installations represent an escalation of the oil-and-inflation shock that drove QQQ lower on July 22-24, while yields are already reported above 4.69% ahead of the FOMC decision. Although QQQ is up pre-market and one source reports a US-Iran breakthrough, the conflicting geopolitical reports and continued pre-market resilience suggest the high-severity downside risk has not been consistently absorbed.
